{{Top|leg}}
'''Garbage loaders''' were lumbering, story-and-a-half tall [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles that were in operation in [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. Their upper rims had [[Droid/Legends|droid]] arms that seized garbage receptacles, lifted them into the air, and then dumped the contents into a payload bay. They were [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].
